body_excerpt: Some background: I've been trying to map a texture onto a "sphere" using a look up table of texture co-ordinate changes. I can't "pre-spread" the texture of these extremes because the texture offset changes to make the "sphere" appear to rotate. If you examine the code for making the lookup table here, you'll see the approach, and the running demo shows the issue. https://codepen.io/SarahC/pen/KKoKqKW I figured I'd try and come up with a new approach myself! After thinking a while, I realised a sphere texture in effect moves the location of the texture pixel further from the spheres origin the further away from the origin it is! In a straight line from the origin. So I figured - calculate the angle the current pixel is from the origin, calculate it's unit distance, then all I need to do is make a function that is given the distance, and calculates the new distance based on some "sphere calculation". That new distance is almost 1 to 1 near the center of the sphere, and rapidly increases right at the edges. Mapping a sphere texture! That offset function I figured (may be wrong here?)
